_help: One power per key. See docs/ABILITIES.md.

moves.name: Carried Light
moves.desc: Toggle light around you while moving. Costs one aura every 102 ticks.

moves.name: Blinding Flash
moves.desc: A cone of blinding light, eight blocks long.

moves.name: Phare
moves.desc: For ten seconds, nearby invisible creatures within 12–24 blocks glow.

moves.name: Dazzling Pulse
moves.desc: A burst of light blinds and slows everyone nearby.

moves.name: Aiguille
moves.desc: A fast needle dealing 2–5 damage.

moves.name: Fan
moves.desc: Seven needles in a fan, dealing 1.5–3.5 damage each.

moves.name: Targeted Volley
moves.desc: Hold for tight volleys of five needles, dealing 3–6 damage each. Costs six aura per volley.

moves.name: Analyse au toucher
moves.desc: Analyses the hit creature within 4.5 blocks: power, rank, level, highest stat and aura.

moves.name: Lunette d'aura
moves.desc: Interrupteur : analyse en continu ce que tu regardes (30 blocs).

moves.name: Tir arcanique
moves.desc: Hold to charge for up to 2.5 seconds, then release to fire. Taking a hit interrupts the charge.

moves.name: Salve arcanique
moves.desc: Seven bolts in a fan.

moves.name: Catalyse
moves.desc: Gives the targeted creature, or yourself while crouching, one random mutation for thirty seconds. More than three causes overload.

moves.name: Table rase
moves.desc: Efface mutations et effets de la cible (accroupi : toi).

moves.name: Genetic Stasis
moves.desc: Suspends the targeted player's ability for ten seconds, within twenty-eight blocks.

moves.name: Infusion
moves.desc: With exactly one active mutation, strengthens it and extends its duration to sixty seconds.

moves.name: Lacerating Embrace
moves.desc: Grab a nearby target. The mark grows while held, then tears them when released or when the grab ends.

moves.name: Toucher griffu
moves.desc: Dash through enemies, injuring and marking each one.

moves.name: Haymaker tournoyant
moves.desc: Arm your next hit for five seconds: nausea followed by reversed controls.

moves.name: Low Blow
moves.desc: Feinte puis crochet : plus fort si la cible te regardait (3 puis 4,5).

moves.name: Tissage
moves.desc: For six seconds, incoming melee damage is reduced by 25% and attackers are stunned.

moves.name: Fente
moves.desc: Dash and stab the first enemy for nine damage, bleeding and slowness.

moves.name: Croissant
moves.desc: Throw an energy crescent that travels twenty-two blocks, pierces three targets and deals seven damage.

moves.name: Frappe de paume
moves.desc: A white-hot palm deals 7–13 damage by level and ignites its target.

moves.name: Paume de fonte
moves.desc: Toggle cooking of the held item, one unit at a time.

moves.name: Missile
moves.desc: Hold to prime for up to three seconds, then release to throw. Longer charges create larger explosions. Taking a hit interrupts charging.

moves.name: Jumeaux
moves.desc: Un missile de chaque main. Accroupi (+10 aura) : quatre missiles en gerbe qui reviennent vers ton regard.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.desc: Hold to stream small missiles, costing two aura each.

moves.name: Ogive
moves.desc: Hold to prime a huge warhead for up to four seconds, then release. Slow but devastating.

moves.name: Giant Fist
moves.desc: Hold to charge for up to 2.75 seconds, then release a giant spectral fist dealing 7–13 damage.

moves.name: Un-deux
moves.desc: One fist from each hand, four ticks apart.

moves.name: Meteor
moves.desc: Rise as a giant fist forms over the target, then crashes down for thirteen area damage.

moves.name: Rafale de coups
moves.desc: For three seconds, unleash a storm of punches in front of you, within 3.8 blocks.

moves.name: Push
moves.desc: Hold to gather strength for up to 2.5 seconds, then release a giant palm for 5–9 damage and strong knockback.

moves.name: Volley
moves.desc: Five small hands in a quick fan.

moves.name: Paume
moves.desc: A huge hand strikes the targeted area for eleven damage, stunning targets and breaking glass.

moves.name: Onde
moves.desc: A force cone pushes back everything, including arrows.

moves.name: Fente
moves.desc: Dash where you look and strike the first enemy for seven damage and slowness.

moves.name: Posture d'assaut
moves.desc: For twenty seconds, gain very fast attacks and movement with reduced knockback. Requires recovery afterwards.

moves.name: Combo
moves.desc: Combo de cinq coups sur la cible devant toi ; le dernier est fort et repousse.

moves.name: Poursuite
moves.desc: A fast dash strikes anyone ahead or provides an escape.

moves.name: Adrenaline
moves.desc: Immediately restores four HP and grants Speed II for five seconds.

moves.name: Martyr
moves.desc: Toggle damage sharing: allies within eight blocks take 70% of incoming damage; you take the remainder.

moves.name: Frappe de pierre
moves.desc: A heavy stone punch deals 6–10 damage by level and knocks targets back.

moves.name: Garde de pierre
moves.desc: Toggle raised stone arms: incoming damage reduced by 15%, increased knockback resistance and slower movement.

moves.name: Rush
moves.desc: Toggle +55% movement speed and a speed trail.

moves.name: Flash Dash
moves.desc: Bond fulgurant droit devant.

moves.name: Durcir
moves.desc: For four seconds, reduce damage by 60–85% and reflect 1.5 damage to attackers. Sprinting is disabled.

moves.name: Immobile
moves.desc: Toggle grounding: resist displacement and reduce damage by 25%, but cannot walk.

moves.name: Axe Kick
moves.desc: Drop your heel ahead for 5–11 damage by level and slowness.

moves.name: Balayage
moves.desc: A low spinning strike knocks down and slows nearby targets.

moves.name: Frappe au sol
moves.desc: Bond puis plongeon vers ton regard : l'impact projette et blesse tout autour.

moves.name: Haymaker
moves.desc: Arm your next hit for five seconds: +8–16 damage by level and strong launch.

moves.name: Bris de garde
moves.desc: Arm your next hit for five seconds: break shields and make the target take 25% more damage.

moves.name: Frappe au sol
moves.desc: Strike the ground to launch and damage nearby targets.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.desc: Hold while grounded to shake the ground within eleven blocks. You remain stationary.

moves.name: Faille
moves.desc: A ground wave launches anything standing on it and deals six damage.

moves.name: Magnitude
moves.desc: Toggle magnitude to strengthen seismic hits. Costs one aura every eighteen ticks.

moves.name: Seismic Shard
moves.desc: Frappe le sol : un anneau de force repousse tout (16 blocs). Accroupi : Cataclysme, cinq ondes successives.

moves.name: Self-Heal
moves.desc: Hold to restore two HP per second.

moves.name: Marquer
moves.desc: Mark the targeted creature with a glow for ranged healing.

moves.name: Ranged Heal
moves.desc: Hold to apply Regeneration II to your marked target within ten blocks.

moves.name: Emergency Heal
moves.desc: Heal allies within eight blocks at once; you are weakened for four seconds.

moves.name: Lightning
moves.desc: Fire a lightning bolt that slows its target.

moves.name: Electric Touch
moves.desc: Electrocute the nearest target ahead for heavy damage, slowness and weakness.

moves.name: Course foudroyante
moves.desc: Hold to rush straight ahead at high speed.

moves.name: Rayon foudroyant
moves.desc: Hold to fire a continuous lightning beam.

moves.name: Assaut arachnide
moves.desc: Coups de pattes sur tout ce qui est devant toi (3,8 blocs).

moves.name: Pattes gardiennes
moves.desc: For six seconds, incoming damage is multiplied by 0.65.

moves.name: Bond arachnide
moves.desc: Grand bond.

moves.name: Charge empalante
moves.desc: Charge en avant et empale ce qui est sur la route.

moves.name: Arc-boutant
moves.desc: For three seconds, incoming damage is halved and movement is slowed.

moves.name: Charge de garde
moves.desc: A shoulder charge stuns anyone hit with slowness and weakness.

moves.name: Plate Shedding
moves.desc: Plates burst outwards, then reform, granting speed and resistance.

moves.name: Salve de plaques
moves.desc: Five plates in a fan; each removes two armour from its target for eight seconds.

moves.name: Disques en orbite
moves.desc: Toggle two orbiting discs: +6 armour, 16–28% damage reduction, frontal projectiles reflected for three aura, and slightly slower movement.

moves.name: Lancer un disque
moves.desc: Throw a disc twenty-eight blocks for 7–11 damage. It reforms in 9–14 seconds. Level determines whether you hold three to six discs.

moves.name: Hover Disc
moves.desc: Toggle riding a disc: flight and +30% speed. Jump to rise; crouch to descend.

moves.name: Croissant
moves.desc: Hold to charge for up to three seconds, then release an aura crescent dealing 6–12 damage.

moves.name: Jumeaux
moves.desc: Deux croissants devant toi. Accroupi : deux croissants plus forts qui transpercent.

moves.name: Fan
moves.desc: Five small crescents in a quick fan.

moves.name: Grand croissant
moves.desc: Hold for up to four seconds to release a huge twin crescent that cuts through its path.

moves.name: Demonic Leap
moves.desc: Leap forward and slash the first enemy for 7–15 damage by level.

moves.name: Eviscerating Slash
moves.desc: A heavy crossed slash hits everything ahead within 4.5 blocks for 9–18 damage.

moves.name: Feral Focus
moves.desc: Toggle larger claws for +4–11 damage and +12% movement speed.

moves.name: Detonation
moves.desc: Hold to charge for up to ten seconds, then release an explosion at your aim within twelve blocks. You are immune to explosions and their knockback.

moves.name: Onde explosive
moves.desc: Explode around yourself within ten blocks for 12–14 damage.

moves.name: Cluster Detonation
moves.desc: Hold for small explosions every 0.6 seconds, costing ten aura each.

moves.name: Cape optique
moves.desc: Remain invisible while active, cushion falls and become difficult for monsters to detect. Attacking reveals you for one second.

moves.name: Shared Cloak
moves.desc: Cloak the ally you aim at, from your group or school and within twelve blocks, for ten seconds.

moves.name: Champ de terreur
moves.desc: Toggle darkness within eight blocks, slowing nearby targets amid whispers.

moves.name: Hallucination
moves.desc: Terrify a target within eighteen blocks with slowness, darkness, blindness and weakness.

moves.name: Pic de panique
moves.desc: Grab the targeted enemy and throw them in terror.

moves.name: Boule de flamme
moves.desc: Hold to charge for up to ten seconds, then release. Longer charges create larger explosions.

moves.name: Triple Volley
moves.desc: Throw three fireballs at once.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.desc: A 9.5-block wind cone deals seven damage, strong knockback and slowness.

moves.name: Cyclone
moves.desc: Open a vortex that pulls everything within 8.5 blocks for one second.

moves.name: Vol
moves.desc: Toggle wind flight, costing one aura every five ticks. Jump to rise; crouch to descend.

moves.name: Bouclier de vent
moves.desc: Hold to deflect arrows and thrown projectiles within four blocks.

moves.name: Azure Storm
moves.desc: Toggle a five-block storm that lifts and damages targets.

moves.name: Garde du vent
moves.desc: For six seconds, approaching projectiles are deflected.

moves.name: Storm Flight
moves.desc: Interrupteur : tu voles.

moves.name: Lance cyclone
moves.desc: A wind spear pierces a twenty-block line and lifts targets.

moves.name: Fouet de lianes
moves.desc: Hold to guide a vine. It lashes for four damage and grabs the first enemy in your sightline, carrying them ahead of you.

moves.name: Entrave
moves.desc: Throw vines over a six-block area, binding targets for five seconds and preventing sprinting or jumping. Crouching casts Thorn Prison for twenty-six aura, creating a hedge for two hundred ticks.

moves.name: Thorns
moves.desc: Five vine thorns in a fan deal four damage each. Crouching creates four stakes at your aim for seven damage and stun.

moves.name: Embrace
moves.desc: Hold to grow a vine field at your aim, slowing and damaging its occupants.

moves.name: Lasso d'aura
moves.desc: Throw an aura loop to bind a target, with up to two links. Crouch to sever the latest link. Deactivating the power severs all links.

moves.name: Transfert
moves.desc: Hold to give aura to linked allies. Crouch to draw aura from linked targets instead.

moves.name: Restauration
moves.desc: Hold to heal linked allies with aura. Crouch to drain their health instead.

moves.name: Control
moves.desc: Hold to pull linked targets towards you. Crouch to restrain them with increasing force.

moves.name: Rayon
moves.desc: Hold a long beam with thirty-two-block range. Crouch on activation for an energy wave that extends after half a second.

moves.name: Energy Sphere
moves.desc: Throw a sphere that explodes for twenty damage. Requires 150 aura and consumes fifty.

moves.name: Shockwave
moves.desc: Violently repel everything within twelve blocks.

moves.name: Propulsion
moves.desc: Launch yourself in the direction you face without fall damage.

moves.name: Verrouillage
moves.desc: Lock a target within 40–55 blocks, see them through walls and deal 1.2–1.5 times damage to them.

moves.name: Heightened Senses
moves.desc: Hold to see living beings through walls at twenty-four blocks or more. Movement is slowed.

moves.name: Predator Rush
moves.desc: Dash to the locked target for 8–14 arrival damage, slowness and weakness. Without a target, perform a simple leap.

moves.name: Brise-sol
moves.desc: Strike the ground to send a twelve-block wave that launches targets for five or more damage.

moves.name: Transformation
moves.desc: Toggle the beast: +3 damage, increased speed, +0.25 knockback and +5 lock-on range.

moves.name: Prise
moves.desc: Grab the nearest non-boss enemy ahead within 4.5 blocks for eight seconds, dealing 1.5 damage per second. Taking a hit breaks the grab.

moves.name: Lancer
moves.desc: Throw your captive for six damage and slowness; a wall impact adds five damage.

moves.name: Dive
moves.desc: Dive into the ground or a wall and slide up to forty blocks while invulnerable and invisible. Costs one aura every seven ticks. Press again to emerge.

moves.name: Assaut d'ombre
moves.desc: Erupt from shadow, repelling and blinding nearby enemies for nine damage, or thirteen just after emerging.

moves.name: Raise Barrier
moves.desc: Raise one sphere around yourself. Crouch to place up to two external barriers at your aim, or recall the barrier you look at.

moves.name: Expand Barriers
moves.desc: Expand all your barriers. Crouch to contract them and crush their occupants.

moves.name: Ram
moves.desc: Charge behind a shield, launching anything ahead.

moves.name: Changer de posture
moves.desc: Switch between Utility and Offensive move bars.

moves.name: Flux du temps
moves.desc: Toggle acceleration in Utility mode, or slow everything within eight blocks in Offensive mode.

moves.name: Rewind
moves.desc: Rewind yourself, or the targeted ally while crouching, by three seconds: restore position and health and remove negative effects.

moves.name: Time Shift
moves.desc: Jump eight blocks forwards. Crouch to return to the starting point.

moves.name: Time Freeze
moves.desc: Freeze creatures and projectiles ahead within twenty blocks for two to four seconds.

moves.name: Frappe temporelle
moves.desc: Appear behind a target within twelve blocks and strike.

moves.name: Delayed Strike
moves.desc: Mark a target within twelve blocks. The strike lands three seconds later.

moves.name: Pulsion de sommeil
moves.desc: Put everyone within 6.5–10 blocks to sleep. A hit of six or more wakes them.

moves.name: Imperious Gaze
moves.desc: Command a target within 16–26 blocks to remain still. A hit of eight or more shortens the effect.

moves.name: Hypnose profonde
moves.desc: Hold to immobilise a target after concentrating briefly. You cannot act otherwise. A hit of twelve or more frees them.

moves.name: Memory Erasure
moves.desc: Embrume l'esprit de la cible : elle devient aveugle puis titube.

moves.name: Copier
moves.desc: Copy the power of a player within twenty-four blocks and keep it in reserve indefinitely. Shift + R cycles copied powers, then returns to your own.

moves.name: Expulser
moves.desc: Release all copied powers. This also happens on death or when aura reaches zero.

moves.name: Energy Blade
moves.desc: Manifest twin katanas for +3.5 damage and fast attacks. Crouch for a slower great blade with +8 damage and +2 reach. Press again to dismiss.

moves.name: Aura Blades
moves.desc: Throw three aura blades.

moves.name: Arc d'aura
moves.desc: Un croissant d'aura traverse tout devant toi (10 blocs).

moves.name: Manifestation
moves.desc: Blades strike everything within four blocks.

moves.name: Domain of a Thousand Blades
moves.desc: Rain blades over the targeted area for five seconds.

moves.name: Changer de posture
moves.desc: Switch between Water and Ice move bars.

moves.name: Forme liquide
moves.desc: Toggle a water form: +20% speed and incoming melee damage halved.

moves.name: Enveloppement
moves.desc: Hold to trap a target within eight blocks in water, drowning them.

moves.name: Vague
moves.desc: A wave pushes back everything ahead.

moves.name: Ice Blades
moves.desc: Toggle +6 melee damage and slowing strikes.

moves.name: Lance de glace
moves.desc: Projectile de glace qui ralentit.

moves.name: Prison de glace
moves.desc: Freeze a target within eighteen blocks for ten seconds.

particles._reference: particles.json maps controls to pt_* tags; ParticlesEvents and LatticeFx handle the implementation.

moves.name: Changer de motif
moves.desc: Cycle patterns, or cycle backwards while crouching: Warden, Jailer, Vanguard, Architect. Active-pattern constructs awaken.

moves.name: Condensation
moves.desc: Pattern action: Warden protects an ally, Jailer cuffs a target, Vanguard fires a spike volley. Costs twelve aura and six motes.

moves.name: Tissage
moves.desc: Architect only: place a weave plate at your aim for six motes, lasting ten seconds.

moves.name: Construction
moves.desc: Raise your pattern's construct at your aim for twenty aura and fourteen motes. Blueprints recover after thirty seconds.

moves.name: Poing
moves.desc: A conjured fist strikes ahead for ten aura and eight motes. Crouch to crush a Marked target for fourteen aura and twelve motes.

moves.name: Pression
moves.desc: Hold to crush a target within fourteen blocks. Crouch to place a crushing field at your aim.

moves.name: Manipulation
moves.desc: Lift the targeted creature or block. Press again to throw it; crouch to put it down.

moves.name: Orbite
moves.desc: Orbiting debris repels anything it touches.

moves.name: Domination absolue
moves.desc: Launch everything within twelve blocks skywards. Crouch to slam it into the ground.

moves.name: Changer de mode
moves.desc: Balanced → Offensive → Defensive → Destroyer → Velocity. Each mode changes stats and moves.

moves.name: Scanner
moves.desc: Detect nearby characters.

moves.name: Frappe du mode
moves.desc: Balanced: charged strike.

moves.name: Assaut
moves.desc: Offensive: rapid strikes against the nearest target.

moves.name: Guard
moves.desc: Defensive: toggle +3 Defense and knockback immunity.

moves.name: Frappe destructrice
moves.desc: Destroyer: charged wave that devastates the surrounding area.

moves.name: Dash
moves.desc: Velocity: a lightning-fast leap.

modes._note: Marc's Modes changes stats, physical attributes and move bars with each mode. It has no direct counterpart in the reference implementation.

moves.name: Defensive Form
moves.desc: +16 armour and two HP regenerated every two seconds, with reduced speed and strength.

moves.name: Offensive Form
moves.desc: +5 damage and much greater speed, at a cost of twelve armour.

moves.name: Anneau de feu
moves.desc: A five-block fire breath deals 6–14 damage and burns for five seconds.

moves.name: Surchauffe
moves.desc: Toggle hotter claws for +4–12 damage and longer burns.

moves.name: Blazing Rush
moves.desc: Dash through enemies, burning them for 8–16 damage. Your next strike within five seconds is empowered.

moves.name: Spike Row
moves.desc: Eight spikes erupt ahead, each larger than the previous one, dealing 4.5 damage.

moves.name: Spike Volley
moves.desc: Five spikes erupt successively at the target for 3.5 damage each.

moves.name: Guided Spikes
moves.desc: Four detached thorns curve from your sides towards your aim, dealing 4.5 damage.

moves.name: Champ de pointes
moves.desc: Cover targeted ground in spikes for eight seconds. Crouch and spend fourteen extra aura to form a grid of nine large spikes ahead.

aura_transference._reference: aura_transference.json maps controls to at_*_trigger tags; AuraTransferEvents handles the implementation.

moves.name: Accorder
moves.desc: Select the trait to weave. Crouch to dissolve your latest weave. Copy traits by punching an ability user bare-handed.

moves.name: Weave into Weapon
moves.desc: Weave the selected trait into your held weapon for ten aura. Each weave consumes one aura every forty ticks.

moves.name: Weave into Person
moves.desc: Weave the selected trait into the targeted person, or yourself while crouching, for ten aura.

armament_dominion._reference: armament_dominion.json maps controls to ad_* tags; ArmamentEvents handles the implementation.

moves.name: Forger
moves.desc: Claim your held item for four aura plus value, or a weakened creature with an empty hand for six aura plus value. Store up to twelve armaments. Crouch to judge value or break the held armament.

moves.name: Saisir
moves.desc: With an empty hand, cycle stored armaments. Crouch to store the held one.

moves.name: Balle d'armement
moves.desc: Hold to focus aura at your fingertip for eight aura, then release a piercing shot dealing five, eight or twelve damage by charge.

moves.name: Arsenal complet
moves.desc: Tous tes armements s'envolent vers ta cible.

daystar._reference: daystar.json maps controls to ds_* tags; DaystarEvents and ClientDaystar handle the implementation.

moves.name: Hache solaire
moves.desc: Manifest a light axe whose strikes ignite and sweep around the target. Crouch while holding it to throw it for six aura with a four-second cooldown; press again to recall. Press normally to dismiss.

moves.name: Soleil
moves.desc: Hold to grow a sun on your fingertip for fifteen aura, then release to throw. Crouch to burst it around yourself. Airborne and looking down casts Shooting Star. At night, only an ember remains.

moves.name: Sunder
moves.desc: Split the ground with a long fire fissure. Crouch for a fan; look up for a crescent; airborne and looking down creates a crushing dive.

moves.name: High Noon
moves.desc: Only at noon, 11:00–13:00, once per day and under open sky. For one minute, take only 5% damage with no knockback or negative effects and deal 40% more damage. Afterwards, Burnout removes four hearts for five minutes.

salt_seraph._reference: salt_seraph.json maps controls to ss_*_trigger tags; SaltSeraphEvents, SaltUnboundEvents and ClientSaltSeraph handle the implementation.

moves.name: Lance de sel
moves.desc: Throw a salt spear for ten aura with a two-second cooldown: four damage, twenty-five salt and two-target piercing. Crouch for Great Spear, costing thirty-five aura with a thirty-second cooldown: eighteen damage, sixty salt and wall-impact burst.

moves.name: Mur de sel
moves.desc: Raise a seven-by-three salt wall ahead for twenty aura with a fifteen-second cooldown. It crumbles after ten seconds.

moves.name: Salt Arrows
moves.desc: Fire salt spikes in an eighteen-block cone for thirty aura with a twenty-two-second cooldown: eight damage, thirty-five salt and knockback. Crouch for Salt Seal, costing twenty-two aura with a sixteen-second cooldown: forty-five salt and a three-second root.

moves.name: Seraph Awakening
moves.desc: Black branches unfold from your back for fifty-five aura with a two-minute cooldown. Glide for one minute and deal 25% more damage. Salt affects everyone, including allies. Press again for Last Trumpet within fifteen blocks, applying sixty salt. Ends with twenty seconds of Weakness.

black_lash._reference: black_lash.json maps controls to bl_* tags; BlackLashEvents and ClientBlackLash handle the implementation.

moves.name: Agrippement
moves.desc: Throw a tendril for eight aura with a 1.5-second cooldown. Light targets are pulled to you; heavy targets and blocks pull you towards them. Airborne and aiming down adds a crushing dive for twelve extra aura. Each tendril builds tension.

moves.name: Entrave
moves.desc: Grab a target within ten blocks for twenty aura with a twelve-second cooldown. Press on another target to carry up to three, costing ten aura each. Press elsewhere to throw for six damage, or crouch to crush for eight.

moves.name: Fouet
moves.desc: Three lashes hit the nearest enemy ahead for four damage each, costing sixteen aura with a five-second cooldown. Crouch for Tendril Guard: eighteen aura, fourteen-second cooldown, four seconds of spinning strikes and 60% damage reduction.

moves.name: Storm
moves.desc: Requires half your tension. Eight tendrils lash nearby targets for three seconds, then strike together. Costs forty-eight aura with a ninety-second cooldown.

covenant._reference: Covenant — Sovereign and God-tier rules: docs/COVENANT.md

moves.name: Change Stance
moves.desc: Switch between Legislation, Contracts, Immunity, Constitution, Sovereignty and Registry.

moves.name: Enact
moves.desc: Write a law and penalty in chat: No one may run. Penalty: their Speed. It binds all signers (10 aura). Crouch: repeal the latest law.

moves.name: Terms of Entry
moves.desc: Write entry conditions: Whoever enters gives up their weapons. Collected when crossing the boundary (8 aura). Crouch at High tier: seal a permanent Court here.

moves.name: Fine Print
moves.desc: Hide one law while keeping it enforced. Crouch: reveal a hidden law.

moves.name: Foreclosure
moves.desc: Collect a signer's outstanding debt plus 25% interest (20 aura). Crouch: Exile after three breaches (25 aura).

moves.name: Pact
moves.desc: Offer the targeted person a private deal: my life for your branch. Reply accept to bind both parties (12 aura). Crouch: summon a held soul (15 aura).

moves.name: Endowment
moves.desc: Lend collateral to the targeted ally until the Court closes or their first breach (8 aura). Crouch: select collateral.

moves.name: Proxy
moves.desc: Transfer your wounds to the targeted signer until the Court closes. Crouch: release the Proxy.

moves.name: Appropriation
moves.desc: Use a stolen branch at its original owner's strength, without access to unrelated moves. God tier: wield ten branches simultaneously.

moves.name: Sovereign Immunity
moves.desc: Your own laws do not bind you by default. Press to bind yourself or restore your immunity.

moves.name: Indemnity
moves.desc: Void wounds and penalize their author. Six seconds below 5.0; permanent from 5.0 while your personal Court is active. Press again to lift it.

moves.name: Escrow
moves.desc: Protect one of your stats from collection. Crouch: select a branch protected against theft, sealing and copying.

moves.name: Arbitration
moves.desc: Suspend the targeted debtor's ability until their debt is paid (20 aura).

moves.name: Constitution
moves.desc: Write a permanent law binding all signed people at any distance. Maximum five. Use cv repeal <id> to repeal one.

moves.name: Retroactive Law
moves.desc: Write a law that immediately penalizes recorded acts committed inside this Court during the preceding hour.

moves.name: Total Forfeit
moves.desc: Write a law with Penalty: whole ability. Its clause can collect the offender's entire ability.

moves.name: Class Action
moves.desc: Collect one penalty from every debtor simultaneously, without a participant limit.

moves.name: Jurisdiction
moves.desc: Write a territory name or here. The district becomes an autonomous Court for 24 hours.

moves.name: Sovereign Pact
moves.desc: Write PlayerName | deal. Offer a private Pact without a range restriction. Refusal grants one hour of immunity to your Pacts.

moves.name: Sovereign’s Due
moves.desc: Write a tribute: Speed, Recovery, memory. Every signed person pays once per day.

moves.name: Writing on the Hand
moves.desc: Write PlayerName | message to contact a marked signer at any distance.

moves.name: Ledger
moves.desc: List collateral and laws; from 5.0, show debts and remaining resources. God tier: signer locations and Pacts.

moves.name: Return Collateral
moves.desc: Return selected collateral to its owner. Use cv select N to select and cv return N to return directly.

moves.name: Spend Collateral
moves.desc: Spend selected collateral to restore 20 aura and release its penalty.

moves.name: Summon Soul
moves.desc: Summon the online owner of a held soul from any dimension. Pact souls persist after Court closure and server restart.

counterweight._reference: counterweight.json maps controls to cw_* tags; CounterweightEvents handles the implementation.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.desc: Tap for an eight-tick parry window, perfect for the first two ticks, with a 2.5-second cooldown. Hold Guard for a lower x4 capture rate at two aura every two ticks. Frontal hits are cancelled and banked at x10, or x15 on a perfect parry. Rear hits deal 25% extra damage and break the chain. Perfect parries chain later hits. Arrows unlock at stage II; explosions at stage IV.

moves.name: Wave
moves.desc: Spend at least twenty-four Bank charge in a 6.5-block air cone: 0.16 damage per charge and knockdown. Crouching at stage II uses Kinetic Bound: eighteen charge to leap towards your aim without landing damage.

moves.name: Fist
moves.desc: Spend at least thirty Bank charge on your next punch: +0.3 damage per charge. Crouching at stage IV uses Reknit: remain still for three seconds, then restore one HP per six charge.

moves.name: Point
moves.desc: Stage V: spend the entire Bank, at least sixty charge, on a twenty-four-block piercing spear. Deals 0.34 damage per charge, loses 15% per target and bypasses armour for 60% of its damage.

limit_breaker._reference: limit_breaker.json maps controls to lb_*_trigger tags; LimitBreakerEvents handles the implementation.

moves.name: Flare Bolt
moves.desc: A Ki bolt costs four Ki and deals four damage times your multiplier. Crouch for Barrage: five bolts in a fan for twelve Ki, each dealing three times the multiplier. Ki regenerates by three per second.

moves.name: Breaking Wave
moves.desc: Second Limit: charge for 2.5 seconds and spend twenty Ki on a piercing beam, dealing sixteen damage or twenty-two from Azure, times the multiplier. Crouch for Nova: the same charge around you over five blocks, costing sixteen Ki and dealing seven times the multiplier.

moves.name: Break
moves.desc: Cycle unlocked forms on the fourteen-form Ladder according to Vessel level and stages. Crossing eras takes three seconds, grants invulnerability, costs 10–22+ Grit and ends in a shockwave. Within an era, the cost is four Grit. Crouch to release the form. Active forms drain Grit each second.

moves.name: Rush
moves.desc: Dash to the targeted enemy for six Ki and crush them on arrival; a wall impact creates a shockwave. Sprinting casts Crash for ten Ki, travelling faster and ending in an explosion.

sarcophage._reference: sarcophage.json maps controls to sc_*_trigger tags; Sandshroud toggles sc_shroud. SarcophageEvents and PhageEvents handle the implementation.

moves.name: Tail Grab
moves.desc: A tendril grabs within five blocks, or seven with four Vital Sand, for six aura with a four-second cooldown. Hold for three seconds; press again to throw. Held monsters die and drop Vital Sand, capped at eight per ten minutes. Players can escape by jumping. Crouch for Sand Coffin, costing fifteen aura with a sixteen-second cooldown: crush and suppress a cocooned target, then crouch-press again to finish. Phage: Devour / Spit.

moves.name: Duneride
moves.desc: Two tails: surf a trampling sand wave for one reserve per second; press again to crash seven blocks forwards. Crouch for Sever Tail, creating a hardened tail club anyone can carry. Phage: Burrow / Erupt, Sink.

moves.name: Grainshot
moves.desc: Three tails: fire seven plus tail-count hardened-grain jets over twenty-four blocks for eight aura with a five-second cooldown. Crouch with four tails for Tempest: a four-tailed avatar in a storm, draining two reserve per second. Phage: Roar, Obelisk.

moves.name: Sandshroud
moves.desc: Three tails: sand armour reduces damage by 40% and scrapes approaching targets, draining one reserve per second. Crouch during Tempest with sixty reserve to Unseal into Phage. Phage: Lash; crouch to seal again.

hollow_mark._reference: hollow_mark.json maps controls to hm_*_trigger tags; HollowMarkEvents and HollowDeepFavors handle the implementation.

moves.name: Blink
moves.desc: Cross the gray for twelve aura, less at higher ranks, over nine blocks, then twelve, twenty-four or thirty-plus by rank. Arrival tears and damages the area. Crouch for Grasp, holding a distant target for twenty aura.

moves.name: Void Gaze
moves.desc: Open the Eye for ten aura to see nearby living beings through stone. Crouch for Gray Veil, an eighteen-aura ash cloud that blinds and chokes.

moves.name: Gale Slam
moves.desc: An eighteen-aura cone of dead air knocks targets down and reflects arrows. Crouch for Briar, holding ground with stone thorns for twenty-two aura.

moves.name: Bone Darts
moves.desc: Fire a burst of bone shards for fourteen aura. Crouch, or hold a rune, to open the Codex and buy ranks with runes.

moves.name: Thrall
moves.desc: Bend the targeted creature for twenty-four aura: it follows and hunts for you. Beasts unlock first; humanoids and undead at rank two. Keep one to three servants. Crouch for Borrowed Eyes to see through the nearest servant for six aura.

moves.name: Sympathy
moves.desc: Link three to six enemies for sixteen aura: when one is hurt, the others take 30–75% of that damage. Crouch for Void Gift, lending a charm's strength to an ally for thirty aura.

moves.name: Shade Step
moves.desc: Toggle gray concealment while still or walking slowly: become invisible and lose monster attention at a small aura cost each second. Crouch for Doppel, sending a walking decoy ahead to draw monsters for twenty-two aura.

moves.name: Calcify
moves.desc: Petrify the targeted enemy for twenty-six aura: 2–12 seconds, halved against players.

moves.name: Bend Time
moves.desc: A bubble slows, then at rank two stops, time for enemies and their arrows. Costs forty aura and lasts 3–16 seconds.

dealmaker._reference: dealmaker.json uses DealmakerEvents, PactEnforcement, PactFate, PactLedger, SoulEvents and SoulPlaneEvents in deal/.

moves.name: Contrat
moves.desc: Draft a blank contract, or cancel an unsigned contract you are holding.

moves.name: Selector
moves.desc: Select the held soul affected by your seals. Crouch to select all held souls.

moves.name: Convocation
moves.desc: Summon selected souls across the world. Crouch to travel to the first instead.

moves.name: Soul Extraction
moves.desc: Pull a soul into your hand. Crouch while holding it to shred it.

moves.name: The Dealmaker
moves.desc: The same power toggle as the first bar. Crouch while active to open the Ledger.

moves.name: Bind
moves.desc: Bind the soul ahead to a seat. Crouch to select the seat.

moves.name: Sous ma protection
moves.desc: Take a bound ally's wounds onto yourself. Press again to release; crouch to select the seat.

moves.name: Bound Infusion
moves.desc: Temporarily raise a bound ally's tier. Crouch to select the seat.

moves.name: Self-Infusion
moves.desc: Sacrifice your lowest bound seat for your own power.

soul_bound._reference: soul_bound.json is granted by Dealmaker's Bind action.

moves.name: Soul Creation
moves.desc: Hold your own soul in your hands. Press again to return it.

moves.name: Soul Sanctuary
moves.desc: Enter the Soul Plane and return.

moves.name: Soul Borrowing
moves.desc: Temporarily borrow your Dealmaker's strength. Requires a middle seat or higher.

moves.name: Soul Sword
moves.desc: Draw the Soul Sword. Requires a major seat.

disguise._reference: disguise.json is granted by consuming a soul.

moves.name: End Disguise
moves.desc: Leave the stolen form.
